name: Artificial Intelligence and its Applications in Physics
description: Statistics: random variables: discrete and continuous probability distributions. Law of large numbers, central limit theorems. Sampling: estimation of mean, variance, mean with unknown variance, median, quantiles. Statistical inference (Frequentist): likelihoods, MLE, hypothesis testing, statistical inference (Bayesian): priors and posterior, likelihood Bayesian updating, parameter estimation, marginalization, linear regression, Resampling. Artificial intelligence: types of learning: supervised, unsupervised, reinforced. Supervised models: decision trees, kNN. Classification: support vector machine and principal component analysis. Optimization (grad descent and ADAM), regression, loss function. Perceptron model, activation function, deep neural networks. Backpropagation and regularization. Convolution neural networks.
